tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find verified local businesses on Loomivo by what they do (e.g. 'dentist') and town. Returns which can be booked, ordered from or asked for a quote online.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Verified facts about one business: description, phone, address, opening hours, services or products with prices, and what customers can do online.

tools.name: get_available_times
tools.description: Free booking times on a date (YYYY-MM-DD, business's local time) for a business that takes bookings.

tools.name: create_request
tools.description: Send a booking (kind 'book', slot 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'), order (kind 'order', items [{offer_id, qty}], fulfilment pickup|delivery) or quote request (kind 'quote', details) for the customer. The business confirms it. Ask the customer before sending. Include customer_email so Loomivo emails the customer

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Whether the business confirmed a request (by its ref), with a price for quotes.
